author: Lullshift
name: Typing Drills
description: Short lines to type at your own pace, with a gentle count of accuracy and speed. Install a drill pack to fill it.

help.summary: Type short lines one at a time. The lines come from a drill pack.
help.goal: Just for fun and warm-up. There is no leaderboard and nothing to unlock.
howToPlay: Type the line shown. Each letter is marked as you go: correct ones are underlined, mistakes are struck through.
When you reach the end of the line, the next one appears.
Press Start line over to try the line again, or Skip line to move on.
Accuracy counts finished lines. Speed counts only the time you spend typing, so pausing never costs you.
tips: What you type never leaves this page. Only your counts are saved, not the text.
Stop whenever you like. Your place is saved.
